repos_data.description: Lightweight multi-format artifact registry. 15 formats: Docker, Maven, npm, PyPI, Cargo, Go, Raw, RubyGems, Terraform, Ansible Galaxy, NuGet, Pub, Conan, RPM, and Debian/APT. Single binary, zero dependencies, < 50 MB RAM idle.

Helper to upload Gradle Android Artifacts, Gradle Java Artifacts and Gradle Kotlin Artifacts to Maven repositories (JCenter, Maven Central, Corporate staging/snapshot servers and local Maven repositories).
